text: 🍿 Reacher already has a Season 6, and Season 5 isn't even finished Prime Video renewed the show while cameras are still rolling in Toronto on the "Make Me" season. That's not a streamer hedging its bets. I like it. 💪 Alan Ritchson turned a guy who punches people into a reliable global draw, and Season 4 reportedly pulled 66 million viewers in 28 days. That puts Reacher next to 'Bosch' as Prime's longest-running scripted staple. My only worry is formula fatigue, but the one-book-per-season setup keeps it honest. ✈️ Add to watchlist

🎬 Assayas and Stewart are back. "Spiritual World" looks like the film they were always going to make again. Olivier Assayas described the project as being "in the vein" of Personal Shopper , which tells you everything. Kristen Stewart alongside Vicky Krieps, Riley Keough, Wagner Moura , and Barbara Sukowa. That's a serious ensemble. The Fassbinder regular Sukowa in an Assayas ghost story signals something more European, more patient. Krieps fresh off Corsage adds another layer. This won't be mainstream comfort food, and that's exactly the point.

🍿 Robert Eggers goes full wolf. It earns the hype. 📆 Release: December 25, 2026 🎭 Genre: #Horror ✈️ Add to watchlist Robert Eggers and the werewolf myth feel like a natural fit, and the trailer proves it. Aaron Taylor-Johnson brings raw physicality, and Willem Dafoe lurking at the edge seals it. Same Focus Features pairing as Nosferatu , co-written with Sjón. SlashFilm calls it the perfect companion piece. I buy that.

🎬 The Dave Bautista horror movie Netflix can't stop watching M. Night Shyamalan's Knock at the Cabin is dominating Netflix charts three years after its release. A family on vacation, four armed strangers, one apocalyptic ultimatum. Shyamalan keeps it lean and suffocating for all 100 minutes. Bautista plays Leonard, the soft-spoken ringleader. It's the best dramatic performance of his career, full stop. He makes you feel sorry for the man holding a weapon to your head. ✈️ Add to watchlist
